title: Not selling anything — just sharing an autonomous trading agent I built that documents every trade AND every non-trade
author: Ashish2196
selftext:
Most bots I've seen either overtrade to justify a subscription or hide their losing streaks. Tried to build the opposite — an agent that's honest about doing nothing when there's no real setup, and equally honest when a trade loses.

It's live on paper trading right now (crypto + US/India stocks), non-custodial — connects to your own Coinbase/Alpaca/Zerodha account via API, never touches capital directly. Every decision has a reasoning log: why it entered, why it skipped a signal, why a stop-loss fired.

Not launched, not asking anyone to pay for anything — genuinely just want feedback from people who've used (or been burned by) trading bots before. What would make you trust something like this, or not trust it?
